:::writing{variant="social_post" id="68427"}
From end of year presentations… to the very last day of high school… to celebrating late into the night with friends and family who have loved and supported you through every season of life. What an incredible, emotional, beautiful almost-ending to 12 years of school. ❤️

It’s hard to even put into words what this season feels like as your mom. I keep catching myself looking around at all these moments knowing they are some of our “lasts.” The last banquet. The last presentations. The last walks through the halls of the school that helped shape you into the man you are becoming. And somehow, at the same time, it also feels like the very beginning of something so much bigger.

This small school and this community have been such a gift to our family. The amount of love, guidance, prayer, time, and intentionality that teachers, coaches, mentors, friends, and parents have poured into you over the years is something I will never stop being grateful for. You have been surrounded by such an incredible core group of friends and families, and as a mom there is truly nothing more comforting than knowing your child is loved well by the people around him.

Watching you with your friends this year has been one of my favorite things. The laughter, the memories, the late nights, the adventures, the constant joking, the loyalty you all have toward one another… it’s the kind of friendship every parent hopes their child experiences. Your circle has been such a positive influence and such an important part of your story.

And now somehow… here we are. The next chapter is already beginning. ✈️🇺🇸

Air Force bound.  
Still hard for me to even say out loud.

The sky truly is the limit for you, son. You are capable of so much more than you even realize yet. Your strength, your heart, your discipline, your kindness, your leadership, and the way you care for the people around you make me endlessly proud. No matter where life takes you, never forget where you came from and how deeply loved you are.

I would relive these years with you a thousand times over if I could.

So proud to be your mama. So proud of the young man you’ve become. And so excited to watch you step into this next season of life.

We love you. We support you. Always. ❤️
:::
